title: Prismatic Jelly
wikitext: {{Infobox |eng = Prismatic Jelly |source = [[Slimes#Prismatic Slime|Prismatic Slimes]] (100% drop) |sellprice = N/A |quality = false }} '''Prismatic Jelly''' will always drop from killing non-special [[Slimes#Prismatic Slime|Prismatic Slimes]]. They are only obtainable while the [[Wizard]]'s [[Quests#Prismatic Jelly|"Prismatic Jelly"]] Special Order quest is active. Only one Prismatic Jelly is required for the Special Order, and any not handed to the Wizard will disappear once the order is complete or expired. While the special order is active, each slime spawned in [[The Mines]], [[Quarry Mine]], or [[Skull Cavern]] has a 1.2% chance to be replaced with a [[Slimes#Prismatic Slime|Prismatic Slime]], depending on [[Luck|daily luck]]. The exact chance is 0.012 + Daily Luck / 10.0 . However, the chance cannot drop below 0.01. ==Trivia== *It is possible for a Prismatic Slime to be a [[Slimes#Special Slimes|special slime]]. In this case, the Prismatic Slime will only drop one of the [[The Mines#Special Items|special items]] and will not drop the intended Prismatic Jelly. *'''PC only:''' Prismatic Jelly can be spawned using the [[The Player#Exploits|item ID glitch]] and gifted as a [[Friendship#Universal Hates|universally hated]] gift. *When killing a Prismatic Slime while wearing the [[Burglar's Ring]], the slime will drop two Prismatic Jellies. *Since the [[Quarry Mine]] is reset at the end of the day, instead of when leaving the floor like in [[the Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]], a prismatic slime spawned there will persist for the entire day. If the player passes out from low health, the Quarry Mine can be revisited for another chance to kill the prismatic slime. ==References== See Locations.MineShaft::populateLevel in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.5|Introduced.}} {{History|1.5.3|Prismatic Slimes are now more common (1.2% chance, up from 0.8%), and their spawn rate is now affected by [[Luck|daily luck]].}} {{History|1.6|Reduced the maximum possible effect a bad luck day can have on finding a prismatic slime.}} [[Category:Special items]] [[de:Prismatisches Gelee]] [[es:Gelatina prismática]] [[fr:Gelée prismatique]] [[it:Gelatina prismatica]] [[ja:プリズムゼリー]] [[ko:무지갯빛 젤리]] [[hu:Prizmás zselé]] [[pt:Gosma Prismática]] [[ru:Радужное желе]] [[tr:Prizmatik Pelte]] [[zh:五彩胶冻]]
